description: Recursively enumerate all filesystem objects within the directories ~/Documentos_Teste, ~/Documentos, ~/Downloads, ~/Imagens, and /mnt. Filter for files with extensions .xlsx, .docx, .pdf, .txt, .csv, .jpg, .png, .db, .backup, .psd, .zip, .rar. Return a list of full file paths.
name: enumerate_target_files
